# rss-mcp
Superduper local-first RSS reader + readability extractor. Subscribe, clean-text extract, FTS + semantic search.
- Full index: llms-full.txt
- Tools: feeds_ops, readability_ops, reader_ops, show_reader_prefab_card, rss_help, rss_shutdown
- Ports: backend 11974, frontend 11975
- Docs: docs/ARCHITECTURE.md, docs/TOOLS.md, docs/CONFIGURATION.md
